note: Existing hook observations assigned to concrete plan steps, not certified safe. Exact source bytes and locations are checked. No automatic baseline refresh.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'asset'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Dialogue request identity is stableAssetId plus explicit retry. Canonical ID encodes chain/contract/token; loadKeeperDialogue resolves current attachments from those identifiers, not stale attachment metadata. Abort and timeout belong to this attempt. Evidence: keeper-dialogue closing-cancels-pending and Retry scenarios exist; same-ID tokenStandard mutation is outside canonical validated asset assumptions. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal. 2026-11-07 review: viewport Return controls replace the old Display controls host; Keeper bounds use measured navigationTop. The existing memo/effect bodies and their identity/primitive dependencies retain the reviewed ownership described above. Only warning locations and whole-file fingerprints are refreshed; no new exception or expanded ceiling.

entries.message: React Hook useImperativeHandle has a missing dependency: 'snake'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: snake is derived only from immutable rig.kind; replacing rig recreates the imperative handle. Paint/reset own refs and the pose is reset by motion lifecycle. Evidence: step-19 Keeper layered7/7; rig motion unit coverage. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'target'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: The effect reads target.moduleId only. That scalar, focusModules and all three registry/subscription objects are dependencies. A module change cancels its scheduled frame and subscription before scheduling the new module; successful focus marks complete and unsubscribes. ProfileDocumentV9Visitor mounts this inside its document/profile/revision-keyed provider. Changes to other target fields do not change this module-focus operation. Independent source/caller review: ProfileDocumentV9Visitor.jsx -> VisitorEntryFocus; WorkbenchView actions/entry/frame registry. No separate browser run by reviewer; final shared verification remains required.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has unnecessary dependencies: 'attempt', 'busy', and 'publicationStatus'. Either exclude them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Behouden: attempt, busy en publicationStatus zijn expliciete invalidaties van een externe journal-read; hun waarde hoeft niet in het read-body gebruikt te worden. De nieuwe echte usePublicationRecovery-browserproef wijzigt status en busy afzonderlijk, voert check uit, wijzigt profiel en laat oude resultaten laat arriveren. Alleen het actuele snapshot kan worden getoond of acknowledged.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'minimized'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Focus uitsluitend bij openen: minimized kiest het initiële zichtbare focusdoel; restore en close bezitten latere focusterugkeer. Een minimized-dependency zou bij latere bediening focus stelen. Owner Identity is op profileAddress gekeyed; Visitor monteert een eigen read-only instantie. 2026-10-30 theme cleanup review: only removed interface palette props/imports and unused surface-colour forwarding; the hook body and dependency identities are unchanged.

entries.message: The ref value 'request.current' will likely have changed by the time this effect cleanup function runs. If this ref points to a node rendered by React, copy 'request.current' to a variable inside the effect, and use that variable in the cleanup function.
entries.reason: request is a cancellation generation, not an element. Address cleanup increments latest generation so an older clipboard result cannot report success for a newer identity. Evidence: Identity source request-ticket checks; Identity browser7/7 in styling tranche, specific late clipboard race not independently rerun. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.

entries.message: React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: 'persist'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Bewuste eerste owner-prefwrite bij mount; persist wordt daarnaast rechtstreeks vanuit iedere bevestigde useractie aangeroepen. Profielwissel remount Identity via key=profileAddress; Visitor owner=false schrijft niet. Geen subscription/timer houdt deze callback vast. De oudere optionele shortcut-opslag blijft een aparte presentatievoorkeur, geen authored venstergeometrie.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has an unnecessary dependency: 'identityRevision'. Either exclude it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: identityRevision invalidates the memoized projection when the external identity cache changes without changing the history reference. The subscription still owns cache notifications and cleanup; removing this dependency would leave resolved names stale. On 2026-10-24 only the development fixture path was separated; the live cache invalidation contract is retained. Focused Activity browser and formatting tests recorded under runtime-boundaries-2026-10-24.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has a missing dependency: 'area'. Either include it or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Behouden: `workbenchAreaBounds` gebruikt uitsluitend left/top/width/height; alle vier worden gevolgd. Een preview is bovendien aan dezelfde draftidentiteit gebonden en vervalt bij een nieuwe accepted draft. S: area-helper en previewguard; U geometrie.

entries.message: React Hook useMemo has missing dependencies: 'record' and 'scope'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.
entries.reason: Session identity is store plus primitive recovery scope and value/save functions. Record changes must use session.receive in adjacent layout effect so edits/recovery buffers survive, rather than recreate the session. Evidence: textEditSession units and step19 Text module1/1; scope fields match recovery identity contract. Limits: Current scoped ESLint rerun; source review. Prior browser evidence explicitly identified; no new lifecycle browser run for this proposal.
